name: Block Blast Puzzle
author: Addicting Games
description: Block Blast Puzzle is a free block-puzzle game. Block Blast Puzzle is a free mobile game that turns heads and challenges minds. Immerse yourself in a world where polynomial puzzles meet addictive gameplay, creating a unique and entertaining experience that will keep you glued to your screens. Block Blast Puzzle welcomes players of all skill levels with its easy-to-grasp gameplay. But don't be fooled by the simplicity – as you progress, the challenges intensify. Master the art of polyomino placement, think strategically, and elevate your gaming skills. Strategize your moves, plan your polyomino placements, and revel in the satisfaction as you conquer each level. Challenge your friends or connect with fellow gaming enthusiasts worldwide. Block Blast Puzzle brings the competitive spirit to your fingertips. Climb the leaderboards, showcase your skills, and prove that you're the ultimate Block genius.
